design.amendment: Run 1 (seed 2026100201) never combined outline off with the share-code rounded-zero flag. The corpus has 44 such records; run 1 scored 68.66% corpus export fidelity (294 drawoutline errors). Run 2 draws that flag in the outline-off stratum under a new seed. No capacity, feature or split rule changed. The corpus is therefore a disclosed re-evaluation, not a pristine holdout; the new synthetic test and challenge groups were drawn after the amendment.

calibration.scope: Group-maximum native-tuple residuals on reserved synthetic settings. Coverage needs exchangeable groups; this designed grid supplies an empirical check, not native-game confidence.

provenance.labels: infer() with community-static-2026-10 (community-static-v11), read back through nativeCommands: length, thickness, gap, screen height, drawoutline and outline alpha. Development and challenge inputs are SYNTHETIC; corpus and presets are published settings (not native captures) labelled by the same solver.
provenance.split: hash(export-v1:size/thickness/gap)%10: 0-1 test, 2 calibration, 3 validation, 4-9 train. Groups and partitions are fixed by seed 2026100203 before fitting; all scopes and flags of a group stay together. Challenge: 80 further groups, unseen heights and boundary outline widths. Corpus/presets: holdouts.
provenance.independence: All 996 earlier learner groups and every corpus/preset triple excluded before drawing.
provenance.selection: Capacities from fixed lists, chosen on validation only; refit on train+validation. Calibration reserved.
provenance.predictors: analyticPrevious and frozen learners use the 0.9.0 outline rule (drawoutline = outline, alpha 255) they were built with. The appearance head predicts drawoutline and whether outline alpha is the old crosshair alpha (candidate set {255, crosshair alpha}).
provenance.regimeFeatures: 2026-10-02: the appearance head reads the v6 regime features of lib/solver/ml-crosscheck.js; before, its five outline inputs could not see outline-only shapes and rows deduplicated on them kept one arbitrary label. The ranker inherits the structured ranker features and capacity list. Test, challenge and corpus labels were already seen. The export-state learner v2 (crosscheck-emulator.json) initially added reserved fresh evaluations; those have also been observed in earlier releases and are reused regression evaluations for community-static-v11.
provenance.disagreements: Every exportLearner/solver disagreement is classified: tuples inside the solver tie set are judged by translation-aligned IoU with the old target; others by the dimension-first objective.
provenance.scope: Fidelity to a declared reconstruction only. No native captures; designed groups do not establish exchangeability.
